meta.name: review-plugin
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "review a plugin", "audit plugin quality", "check plugin structure", or "validate a plugin". Review plugin directory structure, agent definition validity, manifest validity for both harnesses, marketplace registries, cross-manifest consistency, and file organization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 校验插件结构与清单,让插件符合发布规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在开发或维护插件,想确保它们符合市场标准
copy.tagline_en: Validate plugin structure and manifests for marketplace readiness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build or maintain plugins and need them to pass platform standards

howto.what: 它会读取你指定的插件目录或文件,检查目录结构、智能体定义、manifest 配置文件(兼容两种工具)、市场注册表、跨文件一致性以及文件组织,最后按照固定模板输出审查结果。
howto.when: 当你提到 “review a plugin”、“audit plugin quality” 等关键词,或要求检查、验证插件时触发。

say.text: 请审查 plugins/reviewer 这个插件
say.note: 会检查该插件的目录和配置文件

say.text: 检查当前目录下所有插件是否符合规范
say.note: 无参数时它会审查当前工作目录

say.text: 验证这个插件的两个 manifest 是否一致

howto.what_en: It reads the plugin directory or file you specify, checks directory structure, agent definition, manifest files (for both harnesses), marketplace registries, cross-manifest consistency, and file organization, then outputs a review report following a fixed template.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like "review a plugin", "audit plugin quality", or ask to check or validate a plugin.

say_en.note: Checks its directory and config files

say_en.text: Check all plugins in the current directory for compliance
say_en.note: With no argument, it reviews the working directory

say_en.text: Validate whether the two manifests in this plugin match
